python3 - <<'PY'

PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

path = '/app/PeriodRate.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(path)
# calculate period rate
df['Period Rate (%)'] = df['Annual Rate (%)'] / df['Period per year']
# Save using pandas with engine openpyxl
df.to_excel(path, index=False)
# Load workbook to apply formatting
wb = load_workbook(path)
ws = wb.active
# Find column index for Period Rate
header = [cell.value for cell in ws[1]]
col_idx = header.index('Period Rate (%)') + 1
# Apply number format and find max
max_val = None
max_row = None
for row in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx)
    cell.number_format = '0.00'
    val = cell.value
    if max_val is None or (isinstance(val, (int,float)) and val > max_val):
        max_val = val
        max_row = row
# Highlight max
if max_row:
    ws.cell(row=max_row, column=col_idx).font = Font(color='00FF00')
wb.save(path)
PY
